title: Braided monoidal category
html:
Remark. Braided monoidal category

Braided monoidal category. A monoidal category equipped with a natural isomorphism \beta_{X,Y} \colon X \otimes Y \xrightarrow{\sim} Y \otimes X satisfying the two hexagon axioms.

Mathlib reference. CategoryTheory.BraidedCategory (class). Import: Mathlib.CategoryTheory.Monoidal.Braided.Basic. Notation: β_ X Y for braiding X Y.
